```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout airbyte-agent-connectors
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          path: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Copy AI connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors
          rsync -av --include='*/' --include='*.md' --exclude='*' \
            airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors/connectors/ \
            docs/ai-agents/connectors/
        shell: bash

      - name: Clean up source repository
        run: rm -rf airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
        shell: bash

      - name: Create PR
        id: create_pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          commit-message: 'Sync AI connector docs'
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: 'Sync AI connector docs'
          body: |
            This PR syncs AI connector documentation from the airbyte-agent-connectors repository.
          labels: documentation, auto-merge
          add-paths: docs/ai-agents/connectors/**

      - name: Enable auto-merge
        if: steps.create_pr.outputs.pull-request-number != ''
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
        with:
          pull-request-number: ${{ steps.create_pr.outputs.pull-request-number }}
          merge-method: merge
```
